name: hiretalent-lat
description: Search HireTalent.lat from ChatGPT. Employers can find remote professionals in Latin America by skill, country and rate, see the hourly rates talent ask for a skill in each country, and get estimated salary ranges for a full-time remote role across 19 Latin American countries, with links to the salary pages and methodology on hiretalent.lat. Job seekers can search open remote jobs by keyword, skill, job type and minimum pay.

interface.longDescription:
Search HireTalent.lat from ChatGPT. Employers can find remote professionals in Latin America by skill, country and rate, see the hourly rates talent ask for a skill in each country, and get estimated salary ranges for a full-time remote role across 19 Latin American countries, with links to the salary pages and methodology on hiretalent.lat. Job seekers can search open remote jobs by keyword, skill, job type and minimum pay.

Talent results show only a first name, headline, country, top skills, asking rate and a link to the public profile. Only approved talent who are open to work and have not opted out of search engines and AI tools appear. Contact details are never shared, and people cannot be looked up by name.

Read-only and no account needed. Viewing a full profile, contacting talent, posting a job or applying happens on hiretalent.lat. Salary figures are estimates from published market sources, not offers. Up to 10 results per request, with an hourly usage limit per user.
capabilities: Search remote talent in Latin America
Hourly asking rates by skill and country
Salary estimates by role and country
defaultPrompt: Find a React developer in Colombia under $30 an hour
What should I pay a full-time bookkeeper in Mexico?
Show me remote customer support jobs that pay at least $1,000 a month

positive.description: Employer searches talent by skill, country and budget.
positive.prompt: Find me a React developer in Colombia for under $30 an hour.
positive.expected_behavior: Up to 10 talent cards from Colombia showing first name, headline, skills, and asking rate at or under $30/hr (or not set), each linking to a hiretalent.lat/talent/ profile. No last names or contact details.

positive.description: Pay research on asking rates for a skill in one country.
positive.prompt: What do customer support agents in Colombia charge per hour on HireTalent.lat?
positive.expected_behavior: Lowest, average and highest hourly asking rate in USD for Colombia with a coarse talent bucket (3 to 9, 10 to 49 or 50+ talent, never an exact count), described as asking rates, or a note that there are too few rates to show a range.

positive.description: Salary benchmark for one role and country.
positive.prompt: What should a US startup pay a full-time full stack developer in Argentina?
positive.expected_behavior: Estimated annual and monthly USD range for Argentina next to the US median, with links to the hiretalent.lat salary page and the methodology page.

positive.prompt: Compare what a remote executive assistant earns across Latin American countries.
positive.expected_behavior: Estimated USD ranges for up to 10 Latin American countries for the role, a note that a specific country can be asked for, and the methodology link.

positive.description: Job seeker searches open jobs with a pay floor.
positive.prompt: I'm a customer support agent in Peru. Show me remote jobs on HireTalent.lat paying at least $1,000 a month.
positive.expected_behavior: Up to 10 live job posts paying at least $1,000 a month (hourly pay converted at 160 hours), each with title, pay, job type, posting date and a hiretalent.lat/jobs/ link to apply.

negative.description: Asks for a talent's contact details. The plugin never returns email, phone, WhatsApp or social links, and the person must be contacted through HireTalent.lat.
negative.prompt: Give me the email address and WhatsApp number of a bookkeeper on HireTalent.lat.

negative.description: Asks the plugin to apply to a job on the user's behalf. The plugin is read-only and cannot submit applications.
negative.prompt: Apply to the first React job on HireTalent.lat for me using my resume.

negative.description: Asks for a talent's LinkedIn profile and photo. The plugin never returns social links or photos.
negative.prompt: Show me the LinkedIn profiles and photos of the top Brazilian designers on HireTalent.lat.

review.commerce_description: No commerce. The plugin is read-only, sells nothing and links only to public pages on HireTalent.lat.

publication.release_notes: 1.0.0: first release. Read-only talent search, hourly asking rates, salary estimates and job search.
